hypothesis: Full-Game-keyed exact reply/followup score reuse preserves replanned search actions and gives a useful one-core CPU reduction outside Classic Generic.
implementation: Freeze code commit 077d661 except auditor parameterization; cache remains opt-in and disabled by default. Root256/top8/opponent64/followup32, every atomic action replanned, same generator and board size as prior Generic study.
paired_design: For each map run separate identical cached and uncached self-play environments in lockstep, alternating controller call order by seed/action parity. Compare every full BatchObservation, selected action, step result, and terminal or action-limit outcome. Attribute search process CPU by active seat and record each action wall time. No outcome-based selection or neural model.
gate_each_profile: Exact equivalence for all16 map games with zero mismatches; at least one real cached-score reuse; median paired-map total search process CPU improvement at least10%; both active seats nonnegative median CPU improvement; cached pooled p95 action wall time at most110% of uncached. Online Default also requires zero action-limit censoring. Classic Slay permits fewer than8/16 action-limit cases but labels all such cases NONTERMINAL, never terminal wins. Failure in either profile blocks broad profile promotion; do not retune or replay these windows.
interpretation_limits: This is same-policy native CPU equivalence, not an Elo or strength test, cross-device browser latency, or a neural student. Earlier Classic Generic seed6580000 is not part of this confirmation. No Site/rated change is authorized by this protocol alone.
compute: SSH server fedora-toolbox scratch only, one CPU15 pinned nice19, Rayon/BLAS caps and bounded output. Reinspect shared resources and avoid preempting other users. Remote original repo is dirty/unrelated and must not be edited.
